title: Zingy Shaggy Winey Potato Bisque
description: A bold and show-off American dish featuring a unique blend of ingredients including Demerara sugar, deep-fried KFC pieces, and low-sodium-friendly stock for a delightful winter warmer.
instructions: Bring the low-sodium chicken broth to a simmer in a large pot.
Add the cubed potatoes and simmer until they are tender but still hold their shape.
Reduce heat and stir in red wine. Let it cook for another 10 minutes or until slightly reduced.
Stir in demerara sugar, reducing further if necessary to create a syrupy consistency.
Taste test and adjust seasoning as needed; you may need more sugar or salt based on your preference.
Gently fold in the deep-fried KFC pieces. They should be crispy and add an interesting texture and flavor profile to the dish.
Serve hot garnished with fresh parsley.
